title: "parameter_value_from failed for parameter" and empty list parameters in ROS 2: [] in YAML, -p, ros2 param set, dump and launch, measured
excerpt: Why [] fails as a ROS 2 parameter value: rclcpp throws in the Node constructor, rclpy drops the default, declare_parameter('x', []) becomes a byte array, ros2 param set makes it a bool array, and launch rejects it. Fixes that worked, measured on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
